'''Coomputu''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Garnib system/Legends|Garnib system]]. It was a [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] and rocky world, [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
